title: ctenitis crinigera
intro: Ctenitis crinigera, commonly known as the Cretan fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis crinigera, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to protect against cell damage and improve cardiovascular health. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its potential to act as an antimicrobial agent, making it useful for wound healing and other applications.
